captions.formal: A small orange kitten sits beneath dense shrubbery, then rises and walks slowly toward the camera through dappled sunlight.
captions.sarcastic: Truly a breathtaking odyssey: the kitten has traveled almost six inches and looks extremely proud of itself.
captions.humorous_tech: The junior kitten initiates a slow rollout from staging to prod, maintaining direct eye contact with the monitoring dashboard.
captions.humorous_non_tech: The kitten approaches with the confidence of someone who has never once been told no in their entire life.
